# gritz

> gritz runs coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in parallel, each in its own sandbox, driven by tasks and events.

Every page is also served as Markdown: take its URL, drop the trailing slash and append `.md`. The root page is `index.md`.

## Documentation sets

- [Complete documentation](https://docs.gritz.dev/llms-full.txt): every page, concatenated
- [Abridged documentation](https://docs.gritz.dev/llms-small.txt): every page, with non-essential content removed
- [Users](https://docs.gritz.dev/_llms-txt/users.txt): using gritz and its integrations
- [Operators](https://docs.gritz.dev/_llms-txt/operators.txt): deploying and running gritz

## Start here

- [What is gritz?](https://docs.gritz.dev/index.md): gritz runs coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in sandboxes, driven by tasks and events.

## Integrations

- [Custom events](https://docs.gritz.dev/integrations/custom-events.md): Send events from any system, such as an alerting tool or a deploy pipeline, to gritz so they create or wake up tasks.

## Reference

- [Custom event envelope](https://docs.gritz.dev/reference/custom-event-envelope.md): The request and response of POST /webhook/custom, with every field, its validation, authentication and status codes.
